title: Immunohistochemical Labeling of Thick Cryosections from Pelvic Ganglia
author: Janet R Keast
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bakcicsw
materials: Coverslip in Vectorshield or preferred anti-fade mountant.

steps.title: Cryoprotect tissue in sucrose PBS
steps.instruction: Incubate fixed tissue in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS; 0.1 M, pH 7.2) containing 30 % (w/v) sucrose at 4 °C for 24–72 hours prior to cutting.

steps.title: Embed, freeze, and section tissue
steps.instruction: Place tissue in a cryomold, embed in optimal cutting temperature (OCT) compound, freeze in a cryostat, and cut 50 µm thick sections. Distribute sections sequentially across sets of 3–4 slides so that each slide receives non‑consecutive sections. Use chrome‑alum‑treated slides that have been pre‑coated with 1 % gelatin, dried, and stored at room temperature.

steps.title: Air‑dry slides
steps.instruction: Allow the slides to air‑dry at room temperature for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: PBS wash (10 min)
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Block sections
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in blocking solution consisting of PBS with 10 % non‑immune horse serum and 0.5 % Triton X‑100, at room temperature in a humidified dark chamber for 2 hours.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody dilutions in PBS containing 2 % horse serum, 0.5 % Triton, and 0.1 % sodium azide. Incubate the sections with the diluted primary antibodies (or antibody combinations) for 48 hours in a humidified dark chamber.

steps.title: PBS wash (30 min)
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in phosphate‑buffered saline for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody dilutions in PBS containing 2 % horse serum, 0.5 % Triton, and 0.1 % sodium azide. Incubate the sections with the diluted secondary antibodies (or antibody combinations) for 4 hours in a humidified dark chamber.

steps.title: PBS wash (30 min)
steps.instruction: Wash the sections in phosphate‑buffered saline for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Apply hydrophobic barrier
steps.instruction: Draw a hydrophobic barrier around each section using a PAP pen (hydrophobic barrier pen) and allow to dry for 10 minutes.
